title: Crew Dossier
description: The frontmatter of a crew dossier: one seat in the crew, what it is for, how to dispatch it and what has been observed of it. Written the first time the seat flies and updated after each team. Filed by seat name, explorer.md.

type.description: the words Crew Dossier, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: the seat's name in lowercase with hyphens, the same name the file is named for; a crew seat carries a name, not an identifier

room.description: the crew room the seat belongs to: flightcrew, cockpit or general

agent_type.description: the agent type the seat is spawned as, or general-purpose

model.description: the model the seat is flown on, named in every spawn and chosen for the work: haiku, sonnet, opus or fable

status.description: whether the seat is one to dispatch today: active, or superseded by a seat that replaced it

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

context.description: the dispatches this seat has flown, a bracketed list of T identifiers
